Karl Rethemeyer is an assistant professor of public administration and policy as well as director of the Master of Public Administration program at the Rockefeller College of Public Affairs and Policy, University at Albany, State University of New York. He received his PhD from the Kennedy School of Government at Harvard University in June 2002 and received an honorable mention in the Association for Public Policy Analysis and Management's (APPAM) 2002–2003 PhD Dissertation Award competition.
